title: Get your Bolt project onto your Mac
goal: Download the project's code as a zip so Companion can open it

steps.find: your project in the Bolt editor

steps.say: Look for Export, then Download. In some versions it is a Download button or a three dot menu at the top right. Guides disagree, so look in both places.
steps.find: Export in the project menu, or Download at the top right

instead.say: If you see a GitHub icon at the top, you can send the project to GitHub instead and open it from a link.
instead.find: the GitHub icon in the editor's top bar

steps.say: Your browser saves a zip file. Open your Downloads folder and double click the zip to unpack it.
steps.find: the downloaded zip file in Downloads

steps.say: Drag the unpacked folder to somewhere you will find it again, like Documents.
In Companion, press Change folder and choose that folder.
steps.find: the Change folder button in Companion's card
